note: four different job statuses all use one colour, so Declined, Complete, In Progress and Ready for Review cannot be told apart
evidence: Colours were compared by the style the product itself applies, so nobody has to name a shade by eye. FOUR statuses share ONE colour: Ready for Review, In Progress, Complete and Declined are all identical orange (text rgb(181,71,8) on rgb(255,250,235)). Only three have a colour of their own: Approved green, Estimate blue, Invoiced grey. The case requires seven different colours: Approved green, Estimate blue, Review yellow, In Progress blue, Completed grey, Declined red, Invoiced purple. THE PRACTICAL EFFECT: on screen a job that has been DECLINED looks exactly like one that is COMPLETE, and both look like one still being worked on. Colour carries no information for four of the seven. What needs to be done: give In Progress, Complete and Declined their own colours, distinct from Ready for Review and from each other - Declined in particular should not look the same as Complete.
